variants.label: Word-chain revision
variants.description: The next printed word updates its part of the sentence and becomes the next lookup.

variants.label: Scheduled revision
variants.description: The sentence is revised; the next lookup is re-cued from a scheduled position.

variants.label: Append-only chronicle
variants.description: Each chosen verb appends a clause; earlier clauses cannot be changed.

rules.choice: Representative chooses one of the two leading words; include ties.
rules.score: Authored action checklist: protective words +1; destructive words -1; other words 0. This is not a sentiment model.
